author: Daniele Morais
title: Tropical cyclone: alerta orange for India
seoTitle: Tropical cyclone in India: alert orange
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "ONE-26" at orange (moderate to high) level.
excerpt: Tropical cyclone puts India under orange (moderate to high) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a orange (moderate to high) alert for event "ONE-26" (tropical cyclone) affecting India.

From the official bulletin: From 22/09/2026 to 23/09/2026, a Tropical Storm (maximum wind speed of 83 km/h) ONE-26 was active in NorthIndian. The cyclone affects these countries: India (vulnerability High). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0 (10.439 million in tropical storm).

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
